description.value: Joe Burger is a fast-casual smash burger counter tucked inside the Country Club Centre food court in Nanaimo, known for hand-crafted burgers made from fresh-ground beef and daily-prepared ingredients. The menu spans classic burgers, poutine, onion rings, breakfast sandwiches, and churros, and the spot has earned a reputation as one of the top-rated burger destinations in the city. The sheltered mall food court setting with ample seating makes it a practical and filling refuelling stop for touring cyclists passing through Nanaimo.
